what: A four-color vertical gradient fills the board (pink at the bottom → light coral → apricot → orange at the top, three smoothstep ranges), warped by four layers of sine waves so it shimmers slowly. Each layer shifts the coordinates in turn with (strength .1, .06, .08, .16 × overall 5, density 1, 2.7, 1.8, .5, speed 1, .8, .6, .4). The color position is raised by .25, then the bottom 40% is melted to transparent so it joins the section below. Time flows at 1.5 per second (at most .05 seconds per frame). On phones under 650px it uses .33x strength, 1.5x speed and 1x resolution. It pauses when off screen (a single three board)

options.amp: Overall wave strength, default 5 (×.33 on phones)
options.speed: Time flow per second, default 1.5 (×1.5 on phone)
options.shift: Amount that lifts the color slot upward, default .25
options.fade: Height share fading to transparent from the bottom, default .4
options.narrow: Window width treated as phone (px), default 650
options.--fx-c1 · --fx-c2 · --fx-c3 · --fx-c4: Four colors bottom → top. If none, pink · light coral · apricot · orange made from --kf-accent (oklch relative color)

note: Load three (0.185) first as window.THREE. Text inside the panel is drawn as is on top of the canvas (z -1). Like the original, colors are mixed in linear space and output unchanged, so they render slightly darker than the hex values. With reduced motion set, only the first scene is shown
